E1285

The jetos VM guest proof has not run.

What

The jetos VM guest proof has not run.

Why

D-JOS-VMCOMMAND1=A and D-JOS-DESKTOP1=A require `jet os vm prove` to record an actual installer boot, disk install, reboot, serial guest verification, and graphical desktop verification before claiming proof. A written harness is not proof, and a guest proof must match the host, generation, disk, media proof, tool hashes, and terminal/desktop/graphical guest assertions.

Fix

Inspect the VM run logs, fix the boot/install path, then rerun `jet os vm prove` to capture a guest proof marker.
